Diagnostic bucket: 9/1 per desktop engine, the failure is **N2-D2** (60 s click timeout) — **identical on the baseline `515dc1d` run [39268393120](https://github.com/DigitalBlueprint239/coach-core-ai/actions/runs/39268393120)** (chromium and firefox diag 9/1, N2-D2 timedOut), so it is pre-existing and outside acceptance. The run's overall `failure` conclusion comes from those two diagnostic jobs plus the merge-eligibility aggregate, which is **INELIGIBLE by design** (R1: dispatch is not a trusted event). The `Error updating stats for play: NOT_FOUND` line in the functions emulator log is also present on the baseline run (legacy `onPlayCreated` trigger), not introduced here.

### R1–R8 dispositions, verified in code and tests

|---|---|---|

Documented in `FILM_S1_BACKEND.md`; acceptable for this slice, must not be forgotten in the retention slice. | `handlers.js` finalize path; adapter test "transient -> throws" |

| R7 rules call count | **Resolved** in rules text (one `exists` + one `get`, evaluated as a value, path-bound `teamId`/`filmId`). Live-project call-count behaviour still unverified (no live deploy authorized). | `storage.rules` diff |

### Remaining limitations (carry into acceptance tracking)
1. Real Cloud Storage generation semantics (R2) and live cross-service rule call counts (R7): unverified; emulator and fakes only.
2. No Eventarc retry on transient read failure (R3 residual); no sweeper for orphaned quarantine objects (retention slice, D4).
3. A `validating` film has passed a 1 KiB container-signature check only; no decoder, no `ready`, no playback, no UI, no AI.
4. All limit and wording values are test placeholders; the policy-dependent checks in `FILM_S1_BACKEND.md` must be repeated when the settled D3/D7 terms are attached, and the deploy guard lifted only then.
5. Evidence is emulator/demo-project and CI-browser only: no staging, real auth, physical devices or footage.

Review complete for this handoff. No merge, deployment, live config, spend or AI activation is implied.
